what: Eufymake states Etsy has a "really easy and fast sign up process" where sellers can "start selling in just a few hours," calling this "much faster than the rigorous application process required by Amazon Handmade."
verbatim_snippet: "Etsy gives you space to tell your story, which matters because emotional connection often drives handmade purchases. If you want to begin selling your products as soon as possible, Etsy is the route for you. It has a really easy and fast sign up process. Once you have your account, you could start selling in just a few hours. This is much faster than the rigorous application process required by Amazon Handmade."
notes: Same source as F-P07. Not directly fetched; verbatim from search snippet. Comparison dimension: onboarding speed / ease of use. Other platform: Amazon Handmade. Stance: neutral, noting Etsy advantage in onboarding. Third-party comparative sub-type (SD-07).
